column3: “Majestic trees” is rendered “glorious trees,” and “the forest of the vintage” “the impenetrable forest,” following the other reading.
“Shepherd” is rendered “Pasture,” and “the flock of slaughter” “the flock doomed to slaughter.”
“Gain riches” is rendered “I have become rich”; NASB adds “own.”
“Deliver everyone into the hand” is rendered “cause the men to fall, each into another’s power,” and “crush” “strike.”
“Shepherded” is rendered “pastured,” and “the flock of slaughter” “the flock doomed to slaughter.” NASB renders “therefore the afflicted” as “hence the afflicted”; the meaning is uncertain.
“My self was short” is rendered “my soul was impatient,” and “loathed” “was weary of.”
“Is being destroyed” is rendered “is to be annihilated,” and “survive” “are left.”
“Cut up” is rendered “cut it in pieces.”
“Refrain” is rendered “never mind!”; NASB supplies “shekels of.”
“The magnificence of the value” is rendered “that magnificent price”; NASB supplies “shekels of” and puts “to the potter” after “threw them.”
“Visit” is rendered “care for,” “the young man” “the scattered,” and “maimed” “broken”; NASB supplies “sheep.”
“Shepherd of worthlessness” is rendered “worthless shepherd,” and “grow dim” “be blind.”
